description: r.main is cancelled (Shutdown) at 0. After a sleep t.0 spawns t.0.c1 into the closing region and try_joins it in the same poll: Rust queued the child and its admission is refused only at the next step, so try_join reports ASX_E_TASK_NOT_COMPLETED. After a yield the refusal was delivered and try_join reports ASX_E_REGION_CLOSED. C used to report the refusal at once (fuzz gen-1-45 and four others).
